positive_snippets:
We had a nice stay here. Comfortable and clean room with all the basic necessities for a short stay. We also enjoyed the hot breakfast in the morning.

The best part is the staff! They were so helpful in helping us out after the airport lost my luggage, and gave us recommendations on where to get replacement clothes while also incorporating sightseeing places in Delhi in the itinerary. They also booked a taxi for us to make sure we got to the airport on time. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for a place to stay near the airport!
Nice friendly budget hotel near airport. Helpful staff booked taxi to airport for us. Not luxe but doesn't pretend to be. Good for departure base.

Hotel staff are a bit humble but consider a very low budget hotel don't expect any set of professionalism.
